$comment: What this repository contributes to a running stack, and what a check may
Two buckets, on purpose (see vouchryx's own copy of this comment, which
this one follows): everything under `checked` is proved against this
repository by internal/manifest, in this repository's own CI, which has
the toolchain to build and RUN the thing. Everything under `declared` is a
statement nobody verifies, and carries its own `why`.
distribution: not distributed: built from source, no tag yet

required_when.why: the OpenAI-compatible base URL to ask (e.g. a local Ollama); there is no default endpoint
the model name to send with every request; there is no default model

role.value: an optional add-on: answers typed questions (choice, score, yes/no) with a probability, over HTTP and MCP, governing what leaves the box and what it costs
role.why: a sentence about purpose is not a property of the source

not_paid_by_default.value: there is no default backend; TYPRYX_BACKEND is required and only 'stub' (free, deterministic, answers nobody's real question) is built in this phase
not_paid_by_default.why: a required variable with no default is read off main.go; that the only accepted value today is free is a fact about this phase, not something the manifest schema can express on its own

backends_not_built_yet.why: named here so a reader does not have to open the source to learn that TYPRYX_BACKEND=jev refuses to start; openai-logprobs is now built (phase C), jev is still a later phase

openai_key_never_read_from_env_value.value: TYPRYX_OPENAI_KEY_FILE names a file path; the file's trimmed contents are used as the bearer key and are never logged or echoed into an error
openai_key_never_read_from_env_value.why: a manifest schema field cannot express a runtime non-disclosure guarantee; stated here so a reader does not have to open internal/backend/openai.go to learn it

the_ledger_is_optional.value: unset TYPRYX_LEDGER_DIR: answers are not ledgered and POST /v1/outcome refuses every call with no_ledger
the_ledger_is_optional.why: an optional value needs its unset behaviour on record somewhere a launcher can read it, same reasoning vouchryx gives for VOUCHRYX_REVOKE_KEYS

role.value: a plain HTTP client of typryx's own /v1/ask and /v1/outcome, not a service: generates a deterministic set of arithmetic eval.outcome_met items and produces the measurement phase E's calibration command reads
role.why: internal/manifest.TestEveryBinaryThisRepositoryBuildsIsDeclaredAndTheReverse requires every package main this repository builds to be declared here; this entry exists to satisfy that, not because this is a service with env vars or a listen address of its own

not_a_backend.value: reaches the network as a caller of typryx's HTTP API, the same shape as the curl examples in README.md; it is exempted from scripts/one-way-out.sh for exactly that reason (see that script's own comment)
not_a_backend.why: a reader of that gate's exemption list should be able to find why here rather than only in the script
